title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A deleted file no longer comes back from the dead
summary: Deleting a file while the extension was still reading it left the file in the index, so Cmd+T listed it and Cmd+click opened a file that no longer existed.

highlights.title: A delete during a scan is no longer undone by that scan
highlights.description: The window between reading a file and parsing it on a worker thread is tens of milliseconds. A delete landing there removed an entry the scan had not written yet, and the scan wrote it afterwards.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: The same held during a checkout and when a whole folder was deleted while one of its files was being scanned.
An edit made during a scan still wins: the stale read is dropped and the newer one kept, so no keystroke is lost.
